svg.title: Fire Commissioner / British Columbia — Maltese cross crest
svg.desc: Interpreted vector rebuild from a 480 × 640 collector-board photograph. Border proportions and caption positions follow the visible specimen. Outlined Roboto Bold/Roboto Condensed Bold interprets the embroidered lettering; exact alphabet, stitch paths, physical dimensions and issue colours are unverified. The modern full achievement uses the exact uploaded native BC arms geometry and original colours, uniformly fitted. This is the user-mandated reference substitution; this small cloth photograph cannot verify fine heraldic lines, calibrated thread colours or stitch construction. The earlier inventory misidentified this as Conservation Officer; the visible caption reads FIRE COMMISSIONER. A manually aligned four-arm Maltese cross replaces the earlier arbitrary scallops. One smooth analytical quadrant defines all four arms and diagonal recesses; exact stitch-edge irregularities and photographic perspective are not copied.
